args.response:
Refined Requirement 37 (Scientific RPN Execution). Addressed three critical gaps:

1. Operand-order ambiguity for two-operand operators (P1) — amended criterion 3 to define first-popped as right-hand argument (exponent/root degree) and second-popped as left-hand argument (base/radicand), so exponentiation and n-th root are unambiguously testable.
2. Stack underflow / insufficient operands (P0 test blocker) — added new criterion 7 specifying the error path when the Evaluation_Stack holds fewer operands than a token requires, using the established Error_Response / Backend_Service pattern.
3. Preserved all existing criteria, the requirement number/title, user story, referenced requirement numbers (17, 18, 19, 20), and glossary terms (Stack_Evaluator, Evaluation_Stack, Angle_Mode, Decimal_Precision, Mathematical_Constant, Memory_Register, Domain_Error).

Budget respected: 1 new criterion added (≤3), remaining changes were amendments. No implementation details, color codes, or message text added; error criteria follow the existing 4xx/no-result convention already present in criterion 6.
